span.boundary_evidence: The source begins with BitBlt at 0x40a284. The final scanline branch ends at 0x40a710, followed by the original 34-byte copyright string. RgnBlt begins at 0x40a732.

changes: Retained the complete BitBlt procedure, all scanline loops, both symbolic mode tables, and the original copyright string. Every body comment remains unchanged.
Omitted the later EASE archive wrapper and include dependency. Copied the seven required bitmap and rectangle equates from GrafTypes.m.a.
Made PC-relative external calls, code addresses, and indexed loop jumps explicit. Selected the short conditional branches, short local loop branch, and quick additions and decrements used by the ROM.
Restored UNLINK as UNLK A6; MOVE.L (SP)+,A0; ADD.W #22,SP; JMP (A0). The source still invokes its macro with PARAMSIZE.
Added DC.B string support to the translator so the original copyright declaration emits its MacRoman bytes. The declaration remains unchanged in the source.

limitations: Byte equality verifies every emitted instruction and data byte. It does not establish the exact historical macro text or archive wrapper.
The caller handles clipping and the cursor. BitBlt itself transfers the supplied rectangle without clipping, as its original interface describes.
